user.title: UniFi controller
user.description: Local API key of the UDM (Network, Integrations). It stays in the config entry and is neither logged nor included in diagnostics.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the UDM Pro Max, on the local network.
data_description.api_key: Created in UniFi Network > Settings > Control Plane > Integrations, or at unifi.ui.com. Shown only once.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn this off only for the factory self-signed certificate. The key is then sent without server authentication: local network only.

site.title: UniFi site
site.description: Network site whose hotspot issues the vouchers.

house.title: House and guests
house.description: The calendar supplies the stays (title = guest name). The selected entities are the only ones the guest account can read and control.

data.confirm_sensitive: I allow cameras, locks or alarms

data_description.calendar_entity: Any calendar entity (Airbnb, Booking, Google or local ICS).
data_description.lead_days: The Wi-Fi voucher, HA account and Maison link are issued this many days before arrival. Login and link become active on arrival day. Default: 3.
data_description.device_limit: Devices allowed to use the same code. Default: 10.
data_description.download_mbps: Converted to kbit/s for the API (100 Mbit/s = 100000 kbit/s). Default: 100.
data_description.extra_days: Voucher duration is the stay plus this many days. Default: 1. UniFi starts that timer at the first use of the code, not at check-in.
data_description.access_mode: One account per stay, or a single guest account whose password rotates.
data_description.tenant_entities: Any domain. Cameras, locks and alarms are not selected: adding them requires the confirmation below.
data_description.tenant_devices: Every entity of the device is allowed, including ones added later. A device that contains a camera, lock or alarm requires confirmation.
data_description.confirm_sensitive: Without this box, saving is refused when the selection contains a camera, lock or alarm.
data_description.allow_remote: Off by default. The account is not local-only for the length of the stay. Home Assistant must already be reachable from outside; this integration opens nothing. Also turn this on to try the HA account over Tailscale (a 100.x address is not local).
data_description.notify_service: e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone. Empty = persistent notification only.
data_description.journal_path: Relative to the config folder, or absolute under config/ or a media folder (Synology share).
data_description.title_blocklist: Comma-separated substrings that are not guests (blocked dates).
data_description.print_event: When enabled, the cleartext code is published on usvegliu_print_voucher and may end up in traces. Leave off unless you print.
data_description.guest_base_url: Public origin, no path. e.g. https://www.usvegliu.fr — guest links become /s/<token>. Empty = Home Assistant internal URL.
data_description.wifi_ssid: SSID shown to the guest under Informations. Empty = the name is omitted.
data_description.house_mode_entity: Owner switch. On = cooling, off = heating. Guests can read it, they cannot toggle it.
data_description.outdoor_temperature: Shown in the corner of the climate page. Read-only.
data_description.pool_temperature: Shown on the Pool tab. Read-only.
data_description.alarm_code: Used server-side to arm/disarm. Never sent to the browser. Empty = keep the stored code.

reconfigure.title: Reconnect the UDM
reconfigure.description: The new key replaces the previous one. It is not written to the log.

error.cannot_connect: The UDM did not respond. Check the address, the port, and that the Integration API is enabled (Network 9.1+, path /proxy/network/integration).
error.ssl_error: TLS certificate rejected. Disable verification for a self-signed certificate, on the local network only.
error.no_sites: No Network site, or the saved site no longer exists.
error.sensitive_entities: The selection contains a camera, lock or alarm. Check the confirmation to allow it, or remove those devices.
error.invalid_path: The journal file must stay inside the config directory or a media directory (mounted Synology share).
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the log: the API key is not written there.

abort.already_configured: This controller and site are already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The site does not match this entry.

init.description: The API key is not edited here. Use Reconfigure to change it.

data_description.house_mode_entity: On = cooling, off = heating. Guests can read it, they cannot toggle it.

dashboard_missing.title: Guest dashboard missing
dashboard_missing.description: The integration could not create the dashboard “{url_path}”. Create a storage dashboard with URL usvegliu-sejour (a hyphen is required), visible to non-admins, then call usvegliu.appliquer_tableau. Other dashboards (cameras, locks) should be admin-only.

owner_dashboard_missing.title: Owner console missing
owner_dashboard_missing.description: The console is not the Location or Stay dashboard. Settings → Dashboards → +, new empty dashboard. Title: Usvegliu propriétaire (Home Assistant then generates URL {url_path}). Do not mark it admin-only: Users with control rights must see it. Show in sidebar. Then Developer tools → Actions → usvegliu.appliquer_tableau. Open /{url_path} or the Console sidebar item.
